from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

# Define the task-specific causes list
CauseType = Literal[
    '行政行为 - 行政登记',
    '侵犯财产罪',
    '物权保护纠纷',
    '产品责任纠纷',
    '民间借贷纠纷',
    '适用特殊程序案件案由',
    '行政行为 - 行政强制',
    '行政行为 - 行政合同',
    '不动产登记纠纷',
    '行政行为 - 行政处罚',
    '行政行为 - 行政复议',
    '执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议',
    '执行案由 - 行政非诉执行'
]

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """A single legal case document extracted from the text."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    identified_cause: CauseType | None = Field(description="The legal cause (案由) matching the provided list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted document cases."""
    documents: List[DocumentCase]
